trickyParts: Since #2496, a row can be stored by a flush rather than by an append on its own transaction. Every such commit now notes the queue: AppendRoomFlush, commitSettlement and Ledger.commit (noteAppended).

This PR's compaction takes the document lock only when it has rows to fold, but #2387's failed-room test needs the eviction to queue on that lock. passRoomLock waits for the lock and releases it, only for a compaction that waits and writes nothing.
